name: RC-B10-0366/2025 – After § 6 – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
part_text: 6b. Highlights the UN Secretary-General’s statement regarding the importance of the implementation of the provisions on security guarantees contained in Colombia’s 2016 Peace Agreement, as they offer a clear and comprehensive framework for addressing the factors and effects of violence that have particularly affected rural communities, social leaders, ex-combatants, women, children, indigenous peoples and Afro-Colombians;
